cloud.description: Morpheus cloud (zone) VMs are created in. Set id or name.

group.description: Morpheus group (site) that owns the instance. Set id or name.

instance_type.description: Optional. Narrows which layouts are considered when one layout name exists under more than one instance type. The layout still supplies the instance type used.

instance_type_code.description: Optional. Same narrowing as instance_type, by the instance type's stable code.

layout.description: Library layout, which selects the hypervisor and supplies the instance type. Must be an MVM layout. Set id or name.

plan.description: Service plan sizing the instance. Set id or name.

network.description: Network attached to the instance's primary NIC. Set id or name.

resource_pool.description: Optional MVM compute pool. Leave unset to let Morpheus choose.

datastore.description: Optional datastore ID, or 'auto'/'autoCluster' to let Morpheus choose.

image.description: Optional existing Morpheus virtual image. Leave unset to download and cache the required Talos image automatically from Talos Image Factory.

image_format.description: Image Factory artifact to import. qcow2 is native for MVM; raw is downloaded as raw.xz and decompressed by the provider.

os_type.description: Morpheus OS type code recorded on imported images. Morpheus has no Talos entry, so a generic Linux is used.

uefi.description: Firmware for imported images. Leave unset to use the platform default; the Talos nocloud image boots under either.

cores.description: Optional core count override. Only applied on a service plan that permits custom sizing; 0 uses the plan.

memory.description: Optional RAM override in MiB. Only applied on a service plan that permits custom sizing; 0 uses the plan.

disk_size.description: Optional boot disk size override in GiB. 0 uses the plan.
